_notes.source: Live product pages read in Chrome on 2026-10-20, clicking every size (and the daily-loss option where offered): fundingpips.com/1-step-flex, /2-step-standard, /2-step-pro, /2-step-flex, /zero; help.fundingpips.com article '2 Step Pro Model' (minimum trading days). Earlier help-centre sources listed in git history.
_notes.pricing: standard = the price shown on each product page for the selected size (no crossed-out prices shown on 2026-10-20, so promo is null). A site-wide banner reads 'Use Code FP: 20% OFF New Users | 5% OFF Existing Users'; no discounted price is displayed, so it is not recorded as a promo. Prices that changed since 2026-10-02: Standard 5% $44/$80/$216 -> $39/$72/$195 (5K/10K/25K); Pro $33/$62/$149 -> $29/$55/$145; Flex $39/$70/$188 -> $35/$64/$175. Reward cycle choice does not change the price.
_notes.billing: One-time challenge fee per account. No monthly subscription or activation fee is mentioned on the official pages. On 2 Step Standard only, the fee is refunded with the 4th reward on the Master Account; this refund does not apply to 1 Step Flex, 2 Step Pro, 2 Step Flex or Zero.
_notes.two_step_pro_min_days: Settled 2026-10-20: the product page shows 0 minimum trading days per phase, and the help centre now says new and reset accounts need 0 (accounts bought before 26 Aug 2026 keep 1 day). min_trading_days = 0.
_notes.one_step_flex: Live page 2026-10-20: one phase, 12% target, 12% static max drawdown, daily drawdown 2% or 3% chosen at purchase (changes the price), no consistency rule, 1-day pass. Split into two tiers: 3% daily $74 / $111 / $255 / $353 / $666; 2% daily $52 / $77 / $192 / $269 / $529 (5K-100K).
_notes.zero: No evaluation. 5% max loss trails the highest equity and locks at the starting balance once the account is 5% up. Also: 1% max open risk, at least 7 profitable days (0.25%+ each) per rolling 30 days, 15% consistency score for rewards. Live page 2026-10-20 shows the Master profit target as '-' (none), so funded_target = 'none'. No minimum trading days shown, so min_trading_days stays null.
_notes.reward_cycles: 2 Step Standard: Weekly 60%, Bi-Weekly 80%, On Demand 90%, Monthly 100%. 2 Step Pro: Weekly 80%, Monthly 100%. 2 Step Flex: Bi-Weekly 80% or 95% (95% needs 3 profitable days), Monthly 100%. 1 Step Flex: Bi-Weekly 80%, Monthly 100%. Monthly 100% applies to evaluations bought on or after 15 August 2026 and needs a 35% consistency score and 7 profitable days.
_notes.restrictions: FundingPips does not accept residents of the UAE, Iran or Vietnam (help centre 'Get Started' and site footer).
_notes.rule_units: Forex rules are % of account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated (or stated inconsistently) on the official pages checked. See the notes above before publishing.
_notes.company_check: https://fundingpips.com/ footer (checked 2026-10-11): 'Building Traders Globally Since 2022'; 'Registered Address of FundingPips: Premises NO. 19948-001, IFZA Business Park, DDP Dubai, UAE'. Trading entity FundingPips Corp (Comoros, HY01223081).
_notes.two_step_standard_3pct: 3% daily-loss prices read directly from the live page (3% option selected, checked it stayed selected): $32 / $59 / $160 / $288 / $544. With 3% daily loss the page shows 0 minimum trading days (5% option: 3 days).
_notes.affiliate_program: help.fundingpips.com 'Become an Affiliate' (2026-10-20): starts at 5% commission plus a 5% discount code for your audience; tiers by referred users - Market Maker 24-99 users 6%, Trade Master 100-299 7%, Market Leader 300-599 8%, Prime Partner 600+ 10%. Applies to purchases on all FundingPips models. Cookie: yes, but the length is not stated (page says check the Affiliate Dashboard). Minimum claim $50 via the Rewards page; payout method not stated. Requirement: you must buy a challenge to get an affiliate link. FundingPips does not accept UAE residents as customers, so a UAE-based affiliate likely cannot join. Comparison sites are not mentioned. Apply: buy any challenge in the FundingPips app, then use the Affiliate Dashboard.

firm.name: FundingPips
firm.about: FundingPips sells simulated funded accounts for forex and other CFDs, with one-step, two-step and no-evaluation (Zero) programs from $5K up to $200K. It began operating in November 2022 and lists a registered office in Dubai, with its trading entity incorporated in the Comoros.

countries.notes: The help centre names only three restricted countries: Iran, Vietnam and the UAE. The site footer adds that services are also not offered in 'countries on the FATF and EU/UN sanctions lists', but FundingPips doesn't list those countries anywhere, so they aren't included above. US residents can't use MT5 or cTrader - only Match-Trader - so the Prime Account and the 1K Instant giveaway (both MT5-only) aren't open to them. The help centre names only the US as excluded from MT5 and cTrader, and says Canadian residents can use Match-Trader (platform details: help article 43468639481105, Account Workspace).
